data.gender_notes: Curr is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Curr (Kurios) is the name of the god of the sun. The name symbolizes the dawn, the breaking of light, and the beginning of a new day. The name Curr carries the meaning “Dawn, Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Curr usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of light and hope, inspiring courage and faith in the face of uncertainty.
data.etymology: Curr belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dawn, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Curr total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: קור
in_hebrew.meaning: קור שמו של נוצרי שמשמעותו 'זרם' או 'נהר'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קור הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו באירלנד ומשמעותו 'זרם' או 'נהר'. השם קור קשור למילה העברית 'קור', שפירושה 'קרירות' או 'זרם קר'. השם נמצא בשימוש בעיקר בקהילות נוצריות באירלנד ובארצות הברית.

in_greek.name: Κουρρ
in_greek.meaning: Κουρρ, όνομα Χριστιανικό που σημαίνει 'ρέμα' ή 'ποτάμι'
in_greek.long_meaning: Κουρρ είναι ένα Χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την Ιρλανδία και σημαίνει 'ρέμα' ή 'ποτάμι'. Το όνομα Κουρρ συνδέεται με τη λέξη 'کور', που σημαίνει 'κρύο ρεύμα' ή 'ποτάμι'. Το όνομα χρησιμοποιείται κυρίως σε Χριστιανικές κοινότητες στην Ιρλανδία και στις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες.

in_latin.name: Curr
in_latin.meaning: Curr, nomen Christianum quod significat 'flumen' vel 'rivus'
in_latin.long_meaning: Curr est nomen Christianum quod originem habet in Hibernia et significat 'flumen' vel 'rivus'. Nomen Curr coniunctum est cum voce 'کور', quae significat 'frigus fluxus' vel 'flumen'. Nomen hoc in usu est praecipue in communitatibus Christianis in Hibernia et in America Septentrionali.

in_english.name: Curr
in_english.long_meaning: Curr is a Christian name of Irish origin, meaning 'stream' or 'river'. The name is derived from the Gaelic word 'cour', which refers to a flowing body of water. Historically, the name Curr has been used in Christian communities in Ireland and the United States. It symbolizes spiritual growth, renewal, and a connection to nature.
